questions.feedback: Mark scheme [8]: test for an empty array [1] and return 0 [1]; initialise count to 1 [1]; loop from index 1 to the last valid index [1]; compare adjacent values with != [2]; increment on change [1]; return count [1]. An equivalent clear pseudocode solution earns the same marks. function countDistinct(values) if values.length == 0 then return 0 endif count = 1 for i = 1 to values.length - 1 if values[i] != values[i-1] then count = count + 1 endif next i return count endfunction
